pintle_throttle.function: throttle actuator driving the variable-area pintle injector (ENG-02 rev 1), rides on the gimballed engine head

v.type: rotary servo + crank/slider (or eccentric) on pintle stem
v.note: Mechanical owns geometry; force direction: N2O pressure should push the pintle CLOSED

mechanism_proposal.tag: DERIVED first_pass_v1.py with ASSUMED 4 mm stroke

force_assumed_N.tag: ASSUMED until combustion.json (lead: tens of N)

full_stroke_time_s.tag: DERIVED (linear torque-speed + 10 ms accel overhead, ASSUMED); requirement <= 0.100 s

stroke_resolution_um.tag: DERIVED at the 12.5 % floor (crank angle -18.7 deg)

thrust_resolution_at_floor_N.tag: DERIVED with ASSUMED linear pintle area law (first_pass_v1)

pintle_throttle.thermal: servo rated -10..50 C: needs heat shield/standoff from chamber head; bracket thermistor logged
pintle_throttle.feedback: AS5048A on crank shaft (14-bit, 0.022 deg/LSB -> ~1.7 um stroke at mid-stroke)
pintle_throttle.harness: crosses gimbal in service loop (3 x AWG20 + encoder 4 x AWG26 shielded)

main_valve.function: normally-closed main isolation valve actuator (upstream of flex hose, fixed side)

concept.v: spring-return quarter-turn: torsion spring closes the ball valve; servo cocks it open through a one-way dog; a holding electromagnet latches it open; de-energising the latch (disarm, abort, watchdog, power loss) closes it
concept.tag: DERIVED trade (REPORT 'Main valve'): NC solenoid with >=5 mm port at 70 bar MOPD not found as cheap COTS

main_valve.opener_servo: Savox SB-2292SG (commonality; only loaded ~0.3 s per opening)

v.holding_force_N_min: 2 x spring force at latch radius

latch_coil.tag: ASSUMED requirement; part chosen after Mechanical sizes the spring

main_valve.valve_body: per combustion.json (full-port 1/4-3/8 in ball valve, PTFE seats, oxygen-clean ASSUMED)
main_valve.fallback: servo-direct ball valve + dump/vent NO solenoid + supercap-backed close (not fail-safe by spring)

igniter.status: ASSUMED until combustion.json selects the igniter; ECU provides channels for arc, spark-coil or pyro types

v.supply: 12.0 V +/-5 % boost rail from ARM bus
v.switch: low-side ignition IGBT, current-sensed; enable needs ARM bus + 2-key + dynamic (charge-pump) gate
modes: DC enable of an HV arc module (Whitmore/USU type: <=10 kV, ~14.5 mA limit, 2-10 W, 2-5 J/start)
inductive coil drive: dwell 0.5-5 ms, up to 200 Hz spark rate
v.hv_lead: silicone 7 mm >= 25 kV lead, own service loop, >= 50 mm from sensor wiring, return to engine star point

IGN_HV.tag: DERIVED capability; arc numbers LITERATURE Whitmore et al. SSC14-X-7 (2014)

v.use: backup single-shot igniter or e-match for static fire

igniter.torch_valves: 2 x NC solenoid low-side drivers (SOL1/SOL2: 2 A, battery voltage) reserved for a torch igniter or flight vent

Pc.model: TE M3234-000005-500PG (0-500 psig = 0-34.5 bar, 0.5-4.5 V ratiometric, Packard A, 1/4-18 NPT)

accuracy.v: BFSL 0.25 %FS; TEB 1.5 %FS (-20..85 C); auto-zero before each start

Pc.thermal_protection: 1/8 in OD SS standoff tube 150 mm with one coil, at the cool injector end; sensor body < 85 C

sampling_Hz.tag: DESIGN (ADS131M04, decimated to 1 kHz for control/log)

P_feed.location: injector manifold upstream of pintle (gimballed side; cable crosses gimbal)

P_tank.note: saturates above 68.9 bar (relief ~75 bar per baseline); over-pressure warning at 65 bar

T_tank.model: 2 x Maxim DS18B20 (wall, under insulation) + optional K-type probe in thermowell

TC.model: 4 x K-type (glass-braid or 1.5 mm MI sheath) via MAX31856 (Adafruit 3263 breakout or on-board)

gimbal_angle.model: 2 x ams AS5048A 14-bit (rev 1-11), SPI, 5 V mode

accuracy_deg.tag: DATASHEET INL +/-0.8..1.2 deg -> bench-calibrate to <0.1 deg with lookup

magnet.v: diametric NdFeB Ø6 x 2.5-3 mm on pivot pin end; air gap 0.5-2.5 mm; lateral misalignment <= 0.25 mm

accel_stability_optional.model: Analog Devices ADXL1002 (analog, +/-50 g) on engine head - optional, TO-VERIFY

load_cell_test_stand.model: 1 kN S-type or compression load cell, 2 mV/V (TO-QUOTE)
load_cell_test_stand.adc: ADS131M04 on ECU ADC2, PGA 64-128, 1-4 kSPS, 24-bit

architecture.v: separate engine ECU (Teensy 4.1) on the fixed thrust structure, CAN link to flight computer

ecu.mcu: PJRC Teensy 4.1 (i.MX RT1062 600 MHz, native SDIO microSD, 3 CAN incl. 1 CAN-FD)

enclosure_envelope_mm.tag: DESIGN v1 reservation (PETG or 1 mm Al); +25 mm connector/cable clearance on both long sides

ecu.placement_constraints: fixed (non-gimballed) structure, >= 100 mm from igniter HV lead path, not on the tank wall; keep feed-line axis free

flight_day_Wh.tag: DERIVED (30 min pad hold + 60 s flight + 3 starts)

min_voltage_at_ECU_V.tag: DERIVED at 3.5 V/cell OCV, ASSUMED 10 mOhm pack

rails.ARM_BUS: VBAT via arming plug + watchdog-gated high-side switch
rails.5V_LOGIC: buck from VBAT via ideal diode + 1 mF hold-up

power_budget.ground_power: umbilical 12 V via ideal-diode OR keeps flight pack full during pad hold (GSE)

latency_s.tag: DERIVED budget (CAN 1 Mbit/s 8-byte frame <= 0.135 ms; PWM frame 3 ms; transducer tau 0.9 ms; sinc3+decimation ~1.4 ms)

physical.v: ISO 11898-2 CAN, classic 2.0B 1 Mbit/s, 11-bit IDs; CAN-FD-capable transceivers so FD is a firmware upgrade

can_interface.bus: 2-node point-to-point FC<->ECU, 120 ohm at both ends, twisted pair + GND + shield, <= 2 m
can_interface.e2e: every safety frame: 8-bit rolling sequence + CRC-8 (SAE J1850 poly 0x1D) in payload; ARM/IGNITE need key = cmd XOR 0xA5 and confirm within 1 s

frames.0x020 FC->ECU CMD_FAST 500 Hz: [seq u8][pc_sp u16 1 kPa/LSB][gimbal_a i16 0.001 deg][gimbal_b i16 0.001 deg][crc8]
frames.0x030 FC->ECU CMD_STATE event+10 Hz: [seq][cmd u8][arg u16][key u16][crc8]  cmd: ARM, DISARM, PREPRESS, IGNITE, SHUTDOWN, PURGE, SAFE, RELIGHT, SET_POLICY
frames.0x100 ECU->FC TLM_FAST 500 Hz: [seq][state u8][pc u16 1 kPa][pintle_pos u16 1 um][fault_bits u16]
frames.0x110 ECU->FC TLM_SLOW 50 Hz: [page u8][7 bytes]: p_tank, p_feed, T_tank, TCs, V_bat, I_servo, counters
frames.0x120 ECU->FC EVENT: [code u8][state u8][t_ms u32][arg u16]: state transitions, abort causes

bus_load.tag: DERIVED (~1560 frames/s x ~130 bit at 1 Mbit/s)

can_interface.flight_computer_side: any Teensy 4.x CAN1 (pins 22/23) or CAN2 (0/1) + 3.3 V transceiver; CAN-FD only on CAN3

degraded_after_s.tag: DESIGN: hold last valid Pc setpoint and gimbal angles, flag LINK_DEGRADED

action_on_lost.RUN: default SHUTDOWN (range safety: no unguided powered flight); policy HOLD_N_S selectable by GNC (REQUEST)

fail_safe_states.ECU power loss: latch drops -> spring closes main valve (<=0.1 s ASSUMED); pintle/TVC servos limp; igniter dead
fail_safe_states.MCU hang: hardware watchdog (50 ms) resets MCU and drops ARM bus -> same as above; reboot lands in SAFE, never resumes RUN
fail_safe_states.Pc sensor fault: RUN: open-loop feed-forward map on P_feed + fault flag; IGNITION: abort
fail_safe_states.gimbal encoder fault: flag; RUN: continue on servo commands (default) unless mismatch abort criterion met
fail_safe_states.arming plug removed: ARM bus dead: igniter, pintle and main valve power removed regardless of firmware

harness_across_gimbal.bundle: P_feed (3+shield), Pc (3+shield), pintle servo (3 x AWG20), pintle encoder (4+shield), TC x2-3 (K extension), accel (optional)
harness_across_gimbal.service_loop: route near pivot axis, >= 100 mm free length, bend radius >= 10 x OD, clamp both ends, PTFE/FEP insulation + glass sleeve near chamber

requests: combustion.json: pintle stroke, force (pressure + seal friction), speed, area-vs-stroke law, valve->Pc plant; igniter type and electrical need; Pc tap location
mechanical.json: gimballed mass/CG/inertia about pivot, pivot location, actuator lever arms and pushrod geometry, hose stiffness; confirm ECU placement and servo flange pattern
gnc.json: gimbal range, rate, bandwidth, resolution; throttle response/resolution; link-loss policy in RUN; GNC loop rate (CAN command rate 500 Hz assumed)
